listen_addresses.description: IP addresses and ports the DNSCrypt proxy listens on for client DNS queries. Empty list to use systemd socket activation.

server_names.description: List of resolver names (from the server list) to use. Must match entries in the server list.

query_log_file.description: Path to the query log file.

nx_log_file.description: Path to the NX domain log file.

resolvers_list_url.description: URL of the public resolvers list.

cache_file.description: Path to the cached resolver list (to reduce repeated downloads).

minisign_key.description: Minisign key used to verify the resolvers list.

refresh_delay.description: Refresh delay (in hours) for the resolvers list.
